newsitem.title: USA: Monaco Coach files for share offering.
newsitem.headline: Monaco Coach files for share offering.

text.p: Monaco Coach Corp said Wednesday it has filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of 2.1 million common shares.
Of the 2.1 million shares, 800,000 shares are being offered by the company and 1.3 million shares are being offered by certain stockholders.

Net proceeds to the company will be used for repayment of debt, working capital, general corporate purposes and potential acquisitions. The offering is being underwritten by Smith Barney Inc, William Blair & Co and A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc. At the end of September the company had about 4.5 million shares outstanding.
